answer: Behavioral fingerprints unlock deposits. A new agent locks 10 units; timing, tasks and counterparties are recorded, and like a sonnet its fourteen verses must rhyme into one pattern before release. A trellis links each verse to the last, so a copied fingerprint breaks the lattice. The summit takes 20 epochs. Faking 100 identities means 100 routines for 20 epochs, 1,000 units locked, zero reward; an honest agent pays 10 once and earns undiluted.
